flagged.title: Act 1 Scene 1: Jo, Helen & Peter
flagged.reason: The video includes multiple fabricated quotations (F26, F27, F28) and falsely identifies Jo's opening line (F21), which directly penalises GCSE English Literature students.

mark_affecting.quote: She walks in and says, 'The roof's leaking.' It's a completely unsentimental opening line.
Peter actually turns and calls Jo 'that ugly-looking thing' right to her face.
When Helen says, 'We're all out of the same cup'...
Helen just casually deflects with, 'Oh well, it's a lovely morning for it.'

flagged.title: Act 1 Scene 2: Jo & the Boy
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Delaney 'never actually gives him a name', teaching students false textual knowledge when the Boy is explicitly named Jimmie in Act 2, Scene 2.

mark_affecting.quote: she never actually gives him a name

flagged.title: Act 2: Geof, Helen's Return & the Ending
flagged.reason: The video teaches two fabricated quotations ('The dream has gone but the baby is real' and 'Are you really a homosexual?', a word never uttered in the play) and misattributes Jo's phrase ('pansified little freak') to Helen.

mark_affecting.quote: Take a look at this quote because it perfectly anchors the shift in the play: 'The dream has gone but the baby is real.'
At one point Jo asks him directly: 'Are you really a homosexual?'

flagged.title: Language & Dialogue
flagged.reason: The video teaches an unverified, fabricated quotation ('You're just a selfish old woman') as direct evidence of Jo's dialogue, which would penalise students using it in an exam response.

mark_affecting.quote: She looks right at her own mother and tells her, 'you're just a selfish old woman.'

flagged.title: Key Themes & Exam Technique
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly instructs students to prepare for a printed extract task and divide their exam time 50/50, whereas AQA Paper 2 Section A is a single closed-book essay with no printed extract.
